scenes.text: What actually carries the heat out of your room?
A refrigerant. Inside, it boils and soaks up the room’s heat. A compressor squeezes it, and outside, it gives the heat away. Then round it goes again.
The catch: many common refrigerants are powerful greenhouse gases if they leak. The Kigali Amendment, in force since 2019, phases down the worst of them.
Better cooling means better refrigerants, and no leaks.
